$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a hair-stylist content seed and a rosewood brand over the sitework register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Hair stylist
description: A hair stylist's studio site: a priced service menu with honest 'from' pricing, draggable before/after color transformations, the stylist's one-chair story and credentials, a live open badge with click-to-call, real online booking for consultations and chair appointments, and a new-guest inquiry form — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this studio's own chair, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Free 15-minute consultation
types.description: For corrections and big changes — photos, honest talk, and your exact quote.

types.name: Chair appointment
types.description: A cut, color, or blowout block — the exact service is confirmed at the chair.

theme.$comment: Rosewood over the sitework register's plan-grid ground — the trades voice worn by a one-chair color studio, visibly apart from the family's contractor orange, landscape moss, and painting plum. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base contractor wears the full-width band and the landscape remix the centered masthead, so the studio takes the pill-links treatment — the boutique read — per the nav-variety audit.
